newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MTD in Chilean property joint venture.
newsitem.headline: MTD in Chilean property joint venture.

text.p: Malaysian property developer MTD Capital Bhd said it has signed a joint venture agreement to develop a 600-hectare property in Chile.
It said in a statement the joint venture was being set up with Jorge Fontaine Aldunate, a Chilean national.
MTD will hold 51 percent in the joint venture, which will have an issued paid up capital of $33.6 million.
The proposed venture was subject to clearance by Malaysian and Chilean authorities, the statement said.
MTD said the construction industry in Chile was expected to enjoy an average growth of 15 percent a year for the next five years.
